story.title: The quiet layoffs sweeping China's tech giants as Alibaba cuts headcount by a third amid AI pivot
story.summary: China's largest tech companies are conducting sweeping but low-profile workforce reductions as they pivot aggressively toward AI-first business models. Alibaba reduced its headcount by approximately one third in 2025, while Baidu's workforce declined by nearly 7 percent. Workers inside these companies describe an environment of constant churn, with roles being eliminated faster than AI-adjacent positions are being created.
